rationale: C12 is a clear drafting template for the child. It uses substantially the same operative structure and unusually extensive shared language: the same two half-day holidays on December 24 and 31; the same coverage of executive departments, independent establishments, governmental agencies, and field services; identical exceptions for special public reasons and conflicts with existing law; and the same treatment of each half-day as a holiday for compensation and leave purposes. The child principally updates the dates and slightly restructures the coverage and exceptions. C04 is also very close but prescribes a full day on December 24 and a half-day on December 31. C08 contains much of the same employee-excusal machinery but covers only December 24 and lacks the holiday-status provision.

shared_material.explanation: The child preserves C12's detailed enumeration of covered federal organizations and field services while consolidating and modestly revising it.
